prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph, shot on cheap colour film with visible grain, at night inside an empty British church hall after a children's birthday party. A long folding trestle table with a paper tablecloth fills the frame, lined end to end with small identical paper party bags with handles, each with a different child's first name handwritten in felt tip. Cold fluorescent teal light from buzzing ceiling tubes, deep shadows at the edges, a sagging bunch of helium balloons and paper bunting drained of colour behind. Paper plates, a half-eaten cake, a stacked pile of plastic chairs. Eye-level, 35mm, slightly off-centre, lonely and faintly eerie, no people. Thanks.
